s.how: Slice 1 red onion and soak in the juice of 2 limes with a pinch of salt and sugar. Toss 600g chicken thigh with 1 tbsp chipotle sauce, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tbsp oil and grill 5 minutes a side, then slice. Char 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels. Mix 150g sour cream with lime juice. Warm 12 small corn tortillas and fill with chicken, corn, crumbled feta, crema, onion and coriander.

s.note: the North Pole, home of the candy canes
s.how: Line a tray with baking paper. Melt 200g dark chocolate and spread into a 25 x 30cm rectangle. Chill 10 minutes. Melt 200g white chocolate with 1/4 tsp peppermint extract and spread over the dark layer, then drag a skewer through to swirl. Scatter with 5 crushed candy canes and a pinch of sea salt flakes. Chill 30 minutes until set and snap into shards.

m.note: the Kringle family Christmas once Nick is home
m.how: Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 40g soft butter, salt and thyme leaves. Roast at 200C for 1 hour 15 minutes, brushing with 3 tbsp maple syrup mixed with 1 tbsp Dijon for the last 20 minutes. Toss 1kg halved potatoes in oil and roast alongside for 50 minutes, adding 4 carrots tossed in 1 tbsp honey for the last 35. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Whisk 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices with 350ml chicken stock for gravy.

w.note: Elf Polly keeping the North Pole in line
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 100g icing sugar, add 1 egg yolk and 1 tsp vanilla, then mix in 300g plain flour. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm, cut out stars, trees and reindeer and bake at 170C for 12 minutes. Cool. Mix 250g icing sugar with 2 to 3 tbsp water, divide into 3 bowls and tint red and green, leaving one white. Ice the cookies and dust with edible glitter.

d.how: Blend 150g frozen raspberries, the juice of 2 lemons, 80ml blue raspberry cordial and 3 cups ice until slushy. Add 600ml cold lemonade and pulse twice to mix. Pour into 4 cups. Top each with a little whipped cream from 100ml thickened cream and a few freeze-dried or fresh raspberries. Serve with spoons and straws.
